_comment: HAND-AUTHORED SPECIFICATION FIXTURE — the person sidecar for corpus.mini.json.
Satisfies the §2.3 integrity invariant for all 44 records:
with the impersonal branch read as the rule rather than an exception: an impersonal
record has no grammatical subject, so it has no dedicated key here, and its canonical
text is the member EVERY key names — all three variants equal `text` and `invariant`
`invariant` is COMPUTED, never authored: it is true exactly when the three strings are
equal. It is what lets a side lane use a record without exposing the person axis, and
it is what `unison` refuses on so a step never renders as three byte-identical strings.
Every `named` variant carries correct third-person agreement — `{subject} obeys`, never
`{subject} obey`. That is the single place the conjugation problem is solved, and it is
solved at authoring time where a mistake is a diffable line rather than something a
`_comment` is ignored by the loader; it is reported as an orphan sidecar key, which is
